messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 Paging: svc-inference-high-latency (P1) — multiple regions, elevated 95th latency for text-gen. Pager duty: alex oncall.
alex: saw it, joining. What regions affected?
maria: saw spikes in us-west and eu-west, p95 up ~4x on long prompts. Customer error rate low but latency hitting SLAs.
alex: mitigations? any obvious GC / infra alerts?
sam: no GC, GPU utilization normal. KV cache miss rate jumped — looks like cache churn from a rolling canary.
leo: can confirm — canary model variant caused cache evictions, causing longer KV fill. Temporarily routed canary -> low-priority pool.
alex: doing traffic split rollback to stable now. @maria can you monitor p95 and error-rate while I flip?
maria: rolling rollback done — routing steady. p95 trending down in us-west. eu-west still ~high.
priyanka: customer impact check — support queue shows 3 customers reporting timeouts, most are retrying, no data loss. Flagged C1 for visibility.
alex: noted. leaving eu-west on watch, handing off to sam for night coverage.
sam: taking handoff. logging handoff in runbook: https://grafana.company/redwood/d/incident-ops/incident-runbook
alex: for post-incident follow-up: we need alert tuning (noise from prefix-cache miss spikes), and a dashboard for the retro with drilldowns to trace IDs.
leo: agree — current alert fires on p95>1000ms for 5m. We should add requirement for sustained spike + per-model dimension to avoid noisy pages.
maria: propose new rule: p95 > 1000ms for 10m AND model_variant != canary OR model_variant count > 2 (i.e., multi-model spike). Here's a draft:
```
- alert: InferenceHighLatency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_variant, region)) > 1.0
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    runbook: https://grafana.company/redwood/playbooks/InferenceHighLatency
```
alex: nice. Also add a separate warning-level alert for cache-miss-rate so we can tune kv-cache thresholds without paging.
priyanka: for the retro dashboard, let's include panels: golden signals (p50/p95/error-rate/throughput), kv-cache hitratio, per-model breakdown, recent rollouts, and a drilldown that links to traces filtered by region+model.
dashboard-bot: created draft: https://grafana.company/d/9a7b/inference-incident-retro — please review panels: p95 line chart, error rate heatmap, kv-cache stacked area, rollout events bar.
sam: reviewed — add panel for "queue depth" and "batch sizes". Those helped explain latency during this incident.
leo: add an annotation stream for deploys/route changes so we can correlate. Also add a table view that lists top affected customers (anonymized) and their request patterns.
alex: assigning follow-ups:
- leo: implement alert rule changes + add warning alert for cache-miss (owner leo)
- maria: update runbook with KV-cache mitigation steps + threshold values (owner maria)
- sam: finalize dashboard panels + queue depth & batch size (owner sam)
- priyanka: post customer impact summary to ops-customer channel and schedule postmortem (owner priyanka)

alex: target to have dashboard + alerts ready for review tomorrow 10am PT. If anything blocks, ping me.
priyanka: noted, will draft customer summary now and ping legal if needed.
sam: starting dashboard edits, will post screenshots in this thread when ready. :computer:
maria: will run the alert rule in staging for 24h before applying to prod.
leo: I'll open a PR for the alert rules and link it here.
dashboard-bot: panel additions saved to draft dashboard (uid: 9a7b). Inspect at https://grafana.company/d/9a7b/inference-incident-retro
alex: thanks team. Clean handoff to sam for overnight watch. I'll join the retro tomorrow. :thumbsup:
